scope: Pre-rollover additive preparation for DAL-GB after the official NFL game center reported FINAL. The exact final, frozen pre-kickoff rating/H4 snapshot, official final inactive inventories, reusable pregame contribution bindings and literal official in-game injury reporting are preserved under Week 6 with the actual recording time. The pair remains blocked pending the official final gamebook and complete paired game-day reconciliation. WAS-SF had not yet been played and is not included. This does not advance the active manifest, publish ratings, write current-week personnel/QB overlays, construct fairs or issue a bet.

sources.finding: The official NFL game center reports Dallas 13, Green Bay 23, FINAL in regulation.

NFL.com's final inactive report lists Dallas players DeMarvion Overshown, Cobie Durant, Alijah Clark, Emari Demercado, James Houston, Drew Shelton and Camden Brown inactive, and Green Bay players Benjamin St. Juste, Jager Burton, Aaron Banks and Donovan Jennings inactive.

NFL.com reports Dallas wide receiver KaVontae Turpin was ruled out with a rib injury, Dallas linebacker Dee Winters did not return with an ankle injury, and Green Bay cornerback Brandon Cisse did not return with a stinger. The roundup does not provide exact departure plays, later returns or complete relief-duty assignments.

NFL support says final gamebook PDFs are exposed from game centers. At recording time, the DAL-GB game center reported FINAL but did not expose a Download Game Book link, so complete final participation and printed injury/return sequences could not yet be source-bound.
